Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the first Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Lightning Runner trigger, causing you to get {E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you can target different creatures with Delina's triggers.

1068-2173-4996.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 6 or higher.
1068-2173-4996.description:
Cast Leveler either from your hand by paying {5} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Leveler enters, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 4.
1068-2173-4996.notes: The mana cost and life requirements vary depending on the position of Beacon of Immortality and Leveler. Your life requirement will increase by 5 if Leveler is on top of your library, and the starting mana cost will then be reduced by {5}. The starting mana cost assumes both cards are in your hand. You must have 7 or more life to get infinite lifegain.
